extractions.value: First report of autoimmune GAD65-positive SPS diagnosed in pregnancy. Patient gave birth to a healthy baby at term by caesarean section under general anaesthesia. The anti-GAD65 titre in the infant's serum was negative. Complete remission was achieved in 2 weeks of the delivery.
extractions.quote: To our knowledge, this is the first report of a patient with autoimmune GAD65-positive SPS diagnosed in pregnancy. The patient gave birth to a healthy baby born at term by caesarean section under general anaesthesia. The anti-GAD65 titre in the infant's serum was negative. Complete remission was achieved in 2 weeks of the delivery.
